summary: Build powerful AI agents & workflows Discussion | Link
content: Keystroke is an all-in-one platform for building powerful AI agents. Describe the agent you need, and Keystroke builds it, connects your tools, tests it, and deploys it to a shared workspace. Give agents memory, workflows, triggers, approvals, and access to 1,000+ integrations. Open source, YC-backed, and free to try with $20 in credits.

chineseContent: Key Strike 是一个用于构建强大的 AI 代理的一体化平台。描述您需要的代理，Keytrip 会构建它、连接您的工具、测试它并将其部署到共享工作区。为代理提供内存、工作流程、触发器、批准以及对 1,000 多个集成的访问权限。开源，由 YC 支持，只需 20 美元的积分即可免费试用。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
